sql: select 'fill' k, market_ticker, filled_at::text t, action||' '||side||' '||price||'c x'||quantity v from fills where market_ticker like '%PALE%' and filled_at > '2026-10-17 13:00' union all select 'snap', market_ticker, at::text, best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker in ('KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT17-PALE','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT19-CEAS') order by market_ticker, at desc) x union all select 'sweep '||kind, market_ticker, at::text, left(detail_json::text,160) from incentive_collector_events where kind like 'book_sweep%' and at > '2026-10-17 12:50'
